listing.name: Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks Recompiled (OGmidway)
listing.summary: Experimental Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks native source project using your own NTSC-U SLUS-210.87 files. The documented developer build has badly corrupted first-stage graphics and is not a playable release yet. Any prepared experimental runtime retains that limitation.

steps.title: Prepare upstream or keep an existing game build
steps.instruction: This upstream project explicitly reports that it is not a playable release yet: first-stage graphics are badly corrupted. Its developer build uses your own NTSC-U retail SLUS-210.87 files and docs/BUILDING.md. Keep that limitation with any experimental native build you register; Portcove does not supply a ready game package or repair the engine.

steps.title: Keep your files and update through upstream
steps.instruction: Keep the game in a separate folder you control, and retain a working copy. Review its executable in Portcove, then add it without changing its files. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage updates, original files, generated data, saves and settings. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external copy. Follow the project’s instructions for the version you use when changing it.
